title: New organization signup through first dashboard view shows zero data everywhere, with no fabricated or borrowed metrics
description: End-to-end walk from signup to dashboard for a brand-new tenant. Chains project.model.js / organization.model.js creation with every dashboard widget's empty-state handling. Grounds TI-003 (Math.random() fake compliance score), TI-011 (0% vs 'Not configured'), TI-012 (NaN%/Infinity% coverage), and TI-021 (literal 0 vs 'No data yet').
preconditions: A brand-new organization has just completed Keycloak signup and onboarding org-setup step
steps: Complete signup for a new organization
Navigate to the main dashboard without creating any projects, frameworks, evidence, risks, or vendors
Observe the compliance score widget, evidence coverage widget, and all KPI cards
expectedResult: Compliance score widget shows 'Not configured' (not a random or 0% score); evidence coverage shows 'No controls mapped yet' (not NaN%/Infinity%); KPI cards show 'No data yet' or an em-dash placeholder (not literal 0) for risks/controls/evidence/vendor counts.

title: Copy-pasting another organization's deep link into a second browser session (different org) never renders that org's data
description: Simulates the most common real-world cross-tenant leakage vector: a user with access to two orgs (or a shared support screenshot) pastes a URL containing another org's resource ID while authenticated to a different org.
preconditions: User is authenticated to Org A in one session
A known deep-link URL exists for a risk/evidence/audit detail page belonging to Org B
steps: While authenticated as an Org A user, paste Org B's risk detail URL (e.g. /risk-register/:riskId) directly into the browser address bar
Repeat for an evidence detail URL and an audit finding URL
expectedResult: Each page shows a 403/404/'not found' state — never Org B's risk title, description, evidence file, or finding content. No partial data flashes before an error state replaces it.

title: Switching organizations via the org switcher fully refreshes all module data with no stale prior-org content
description: Verifies that a user belonging to multiple organizations does not see any client-side cached data from the previously active org bleed into the newly selected org's views (React Query / Redux cache keys must include orgId, and the org switcher must only list active memberships per TI-023).
preconditions: A user account has active membership in Org A and Org B
Org A's dashboard has been loaded and populated with data
steps: Log in and load Org A's dashboard, risk register, and evidence pages (populating client-side caches)
Use the organization switcher to change active context to Org B
Immediately revisit the dashboard, risk register, and evidence pages
expectedResult: All pages show Org B's data exclusively; no Org A KPI values, risk rows, or evidence items are visible even momentarily during the transition. The organization switcher lists only orgs where the user has an active, non-suspended membership.

title: Creating a second project in an org with existing data shows the new project as fully empty across every module tab
description: End-to-end version of TISO-INT-005, walked through the actual UI: project selector, dashboard, risk register, evidence management, and audit assurance tabs must all reflect Project Y's own (empty) state, not Project X's populated data.
preconditions: Org A has Project X with populated risks, evidence, and audits
Project Y has just been created in Org A with zero data
steps: Select Project Y from the project selector in the Navbar
Visit Dashboard, Risk Register, Evidence Management, and Audit Assurance in sequence
expectedResult: Every tab shows Project Y's empty state consistently; none of Project X's risks, evidence, or audits appear under any tab while Project Y is the active context.

title: A new tenant's AI Assistant session never surfaces another organization's indexed documents in an answer or citation
description: End-to-end user-facing verification of TISO-SEC-008/TISO-INT-009 — walks through the actual chat UI rather than the API layer.
preconditions: Org A has evidence/policy documents indexed with distinctive content
Org B is a separate tenant with no relation to Org A
steps: As an Org B user, open the AI Assistant and ask a broad question likely to retrieve semantically similar content (e.g. 'What are our top compliance gaps?')
Review the answer text and any citation links returned
expectedResult: The answer and citations reference only Org B's own documents (or state no relevant documents exist); no Org A document title, excerpt, or citation link is ever shown or clickable from Org B's session.

title: Exported risk register / compliance report file names identify the source org and project
description: Guards against TI-024 — a multi-org user downloading exports from two different orgs in the same session must be able to tell them apart from the file name alone (e.g. before forwarding a file externally).
preconditions: User has active membership in Org A and Org B
steps: Export the risk register as CSV from Org A
Switch to Org B and export the risk register as CSV
Compare the two downloaded file names
expectedResult: Each exported file name includes the org name (and project name where applicable) rather than a generic `vibrantix-export-{timestamp}.csv` pattern indistinguishable between orgs.
